heading: INT. SHUTTERED CAROUSEL PAVILION - ABANDONED AMUSEMENT PARK - NIGHT

units.text: INT. SHUTTERED CAROUSEL PAVILION - ABANDONED AMUSEMENT PARK - NIGHT
Painted horses frozen mid-gallop, their gilt chipped.
A pipe organ sags in the center.
The roof leaks silver light.
Five figures sit on the platform's edge, boots dangling.
DUCHESS, 60s, tiny and elegant in a mink collar, taps a cane against a brass pole.
MR. LAVALLE, 50s, dapper, pocket square, polishes a pair of rimless glasses.
BONES, 30s, long and gaunt, sprawls across a bench seat with a thermos of coffee.
SLIM POLLARD, 40s, round as a barrel, sits with a ledger on his knee.
PEARL, 20s, the youngest, in a leather jacket with too many zippers, spins a lock-pick between her fingers.
Gentlemen. Miss Pearl. We are assembled.
units.name: DUCHESS

units.text: We've been assembled for an hour.
units.name: BONES

units.text: And now we are in session.
units.name: DUCHESS

units.text: Is that a legal term?
units.name: LAVALLE

units.text: It's a theatrical one.
units.name: DUCHESS

units.text: The count is simple. Four million, in unmarked bills, locked in the carousel's center column. The man who stored it was a bad carpenter and a worse liar.
units.name: SLIM

units.text: Which column? There's six.
units.name: PEARL

units.text: The one that doesn't turn.
units.name: SLIM

units.text: They all turn.
units.name: LAVALLE

units.text: Not that one. I've watched it for three weeks.
units.name: SLIM

units.text: Thank God somebody watched something.
units.name: BONES

units.text: How do we get in?
units.name: PEARL

units.text: The same way everyone gets in anywhere. We pretend we belong.
units.name: DUCHESS

units.text: In a closed amusement park.
units.name: LAVALLE

units.text: In a closed amusement park, at night, with permits.
units.name: DUCHESS

units.text: Are the permits real?
units.name: SLIM

units.text: Mr. Pollard, nothing is real. That's the pleasure of the business.
units.name: DUCHESS

units.text: Who's driving?
units.name: BONES

units.text: Pearl.
units.name: DUCHESS

units.text: I thought I was the lock.
units.name: PEARL

units.text: You are both. We are a small company.
units.name: DUCHESS

units.text: Then I want a bigger cut.
units.name: PEARL

units.text: You'll have a bigger bow.
units.name: DUCHESS

units.text: Are we agreed on the split?
units.name: LAVALLE

units.text: Equal shares. Five ways.
units.name: SLIM

units.text: Six.
units.name: BONES

units.text: Six?
units.name: DUCHESS

units.text: There's a sixth share in Mr. Lavalle's ledger. Somebody we've never met.
units.name: BONES

units.text: Silence.
The carousel lamps flicker.
Slim turns the ledger toward the light.
Pearl stops spinning the pick.
Mr. Lavalle. You told me nobody else knew.
units.name: DUCHESS

units.text: I told you what you needed to hear.
units.name: LAVALLE

units.text: He puts on his glasses.
